Definition: The reason and motivation for doing the project. This includes a precise statement of the problem, and its impacts.

Definition: The core set of objectives that must be met if the project is to be judged a success. Be quantitative in identifying the anticipated levels of improvement.
table_name: Table 12-3: Basic Elements of Project Definition

Definition: How everyone will gain from successfully meeting the project objectives. For Six Sigma projects, this specifically includes the bottom-line benefits.
table_name: Table 12-3: Basic Elements of Project Definition

Definition: Identify the team of individuals and skills needed to complete project. The team should be small to remain agile, yet have the sufficient expertise and representation. Typically, a core team of six or fewer are required, with additional help on a part-time basis.
table_name: Table 12-3: Basic Elements of Project Definition

Definition: The schedule includes the total duration of the project as well as the individual duration of each project phase
table_name: Table 12-3: Basic Elements of Project Definition

Definition: Scope, schedule, and objectives hang in a delicate balance. A change in any one affects at least one of the other two. Estimate the risk and impact of possible and probable changes, and identify the controls you apply to prevent them from occurring and to respond if they do.
